text: The Patriots turned in a dominant defensive performance to cruise past the Steelers 20-3 at Gillette Stadium, with TreVeyon Henderson punching in a touchdown as the offense continues to search for the rhythm that fueled last season's Super Bowl run, though the victory came at a cost as starting right guard Mike Onwenu suffered a broken right ankle that will require attention going forward. The win marked a historic milestone for the franchise, as New England became the first of the original AFL teams to reach 600 wins, a testament to the sustained excellence that has defined the organization over decades. In a poignant bookend to the week's events, legendary cornerback Stephon Gilmore, the 2019 NFL Defensive Player of the Year and two-time All-Pro, signed a one-day contract to retire as a Patriot, cementing his legacy with the team that drafted him and defined much of his Hall of Fame-caliber career.
